name: vv-agent-kit
description: Agent practices that survive leaving the repo they were learned in — neutral disciplines plus per-stack instantiations.

plugins.name: vvkit
plugins.description: Portable agent practices: design, planning, delegation, verification, debugging, review and testing discipline

plugins.name: vvkit-swift
plugins.description: Swift and Xcode instantiations of the vvkit disciplines. Install per project, with --scope project

plugins.name: vvkit-go
plugins.description: Go build, test and lint scripts, a golangci-lint v2 config, and format-on-edit. Install per project, with --scope project

plugins.name: vvkit-backend
plugins.description: Database guardrails for backend services: destructive-command tripwire, squawk migration lint, local Postgres. Install per project, with --scope project
